title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection

scenario.summary: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection reported against U.S. Dept Of Defense.
preconditions: The application parses XML input with an XML parser that has external entity resolution enabled

process.action: Identify endpoints that accept XML directly or indirectly (SOAP, file uploads like DOCX/SVG, SAML)
process.expected_observation: XML-consuming endpoints identified

process.action: Submit a DOCTYPE with a benign external entity referencing an internal file
process.expected_observation: File content is reflected in the response, or an out-of-band callback fires

process.action: If direct reflection is blocked, use out-of-band (OOB) exfiltration via a parameter entity to an external DTD
process.expected_observation: Requested file content is exfiltrated via the OOB channel

process.action: Attempt SSRF via XXE (fetching internal URLs/cloud metadata through the XML parser)
process.expected_observation: Internal resource content retrieved through the entity expansion

impact: Arbitrary local file disclosure on the server
SSRF pivot into internal network resources
In some parser configurations, denial of service via entity expansion ('billion laughs')
remediation: Disable external entity and DTD processing in the XML parser configuration by default
Use less complex data formats (JSON) where XML is not strictly required
Keep XML parsing libraries updated and configured per current secure-by-default guidance
